extra.reason: Deleted empty vscode/ dir, replaced dotnet Makefile with biome+cargo fmt/build/test, filled CLAUDE.md sections, expanded README.adoc, added vscode out/dist to .gitignore, added server to pnpm-workspace.yaml

Renamed extension commands to badjuju.new.open and badjuju.refresh.open to avoid collision with LSP client auto-registration of server-declared executeCommandProvider.commands. Build and 36 tests pass.

VS Code status.jj documents are now served via a custom 'badjuju-status' URI scheme registered with a TextDocumentContentProvider, which makes them inherently readonly. The provider re-reads the file from disk and fires onDidChange on refresh so updates appear without conflicting with in-editor edits.

Scoped 'r' and 'g' refresh keybindings to status.jj only (status is readonly so single-letter shortcuts are safe). Log buffer is now free for typing revset characters. Added OUTPUT: heading and a COMMAND REFERENCE section to log.jj. Updated status.jj COMMAND REFERENCE to match real keybindings (n=new, l=open log, d=describe, g=refresh, q=close — removed stale 'c=commit' and 'r=rebase' entries).

Implemented: server renders Mutable/Stack revset shortcuts as JJ: comment lines under REVSET in log.jj; VS Code extension tracks cursor position via badjuju.onLogShortcutLine context key and rebinds Enter on shortcut lines to apply the revset and refresh. All 37 cargo tests pass with no warnings; biome and clippy clean. UI keybinding behavior not exercised in a running VS Code instance — server-side rendering and command logic are tested.

Capture cursor line/char before triggering log refresh; wait for VS Code's file-watcher reload (via onDidChangeTextDocument, 1s timeout) before restoring cursor — avoids race where VS Code's auto-reload would reposition the cursor after our setSelection. Restores cursor to same (clamped) line/char so the user stays on the shortcut line they just activated. Biome/clippy/tests clean.
added 'jj' category to all commands so 'jjlog', 'jjst', etc. fuzzy-match in command palette
added configuration.do (defaults to release) and updated server/all.do to honor debug/release
extension build now copies server/target/<config>/badjuju into clients/vscode/out/bin/; extension.ts resolves bundled binary first, falling back to SERVER_PATH then PATH
added jj.squash_file_into{_parent,} + run_squash/run_unsquash commands; vscode 's'/'u' keybindings in status.jj parse cursor file and invoke server; errors surface in MESSAGE: prelude

STATS marker in status.jj header; badjuju.toggleStat LSP command + '=' hotkey + command-palette entry; parseStatusFile in extension.ts now also matches --stat lines, so s/u work from either the STATUS file lines or the stat lines
'u' hotkey in status.jj now invokes badjuju.undo.open (jj undo + status refresh); unsquash still accessible via 'jj: Unsquash file at cursor...' in command palette
added unsquash line to STATUS_COMMAND_REFERENCE with empty key column and '(command palette only)' note
'shift+u' (capital U) hotkey added for badjuju.unsquash.file in status.jj; command reference updated

run_squash/run_unsquash now accept a revision arg; VS Code's findRevisionForLine walks up from cursor to find the owning commit's change_id (returns @ for STATUS-section lines); both commands send the resolved revision so jj squash -r REV / --from REV --into CHILD operates on the correct commit
squash_file_into_parent and squash_file_into now pass --keep-emptied so a squashed-empty source revision is preserved instead of abandoned

runFileScopedStatusCommand now waits for the buffer to refresh after squash/unsquash and calls moveCursorToFile to position the cursor on the file's new line (STATUS section line for unsquash-to-@, or stat line for squash into a parent)

moveCursorToFile now prefers stat lines (those not matching STATUS_FILE_LINE_RE) and only falls back to STATUS-section file lines if no stat match exists; cursor lands in destination commit's --stat block after unsquash to @
